Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'

p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/krb5/fuzzing/Fuzz_chpw.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":20,"var":"Data/Size","code":"DataInput = make_data((void *)Data, Size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped as a krb5_data buffer and passed into the password-message parser."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/krb5/src/lib/krb5/krb/chpw.c","function":"krb5_chpw_message","line":487,"var":"server_string","code":"ret = decode_ad_policy_info(server_string, &msg);","note":"The parser first interprets the input as an Active Directory policy blob before trying UTF-8 normalization."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/krb5/src/lib/krb5/krb/chpw.c","function":"decode_ad_policy_info","line":394,"var":"data->length","code":"if (data->length != AD_POLICY_INFO_LENGTH) return 0;","note":"A 30-byte input reaches the policy decoder, which then reads fixed-width fields from the attacker buffer."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/krb5/src/lib/krb5/krb/chpw.c","function":"decode_ad_policy_info","line":404,"var":"policy.password_properties","code":"policy.password_properties = load_32_be(p);","note":"The crafted bytes are interpreted as policy flags and lengths that control which message fragments are emitted."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/krb5/src/lib/krb5/krb/chpw.c","function":"decode_ad_policy_info","line":414,"var":"buf","code":"k5_buf_add(&buf, _(...));","note":"The function appends human-readable text into a dynamically growing buffer based on those attacker-controlled fields."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/krb5/src/lib/krb5/unicode/ucstr.c","function":"krb5int_utf8_normalize","line":107,"var":"data","code":"krb5int_utf8_normalize(server_string, &string, KRB5_UTF8_APPROX)","note":"If the AD-policy path does not produce a message, the same input is normalized as UTF-8, propagating the attacker bytes into the Unicode converter."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/krb5/src/lib/krb5/unicode/ucstr.c","function":"krb5int_utf8_normalize","line":170,"var":"Buf","code":"unsigned char *Buf = (unsigned char*)malloc(InputLen);","note":"The converter allocates output based on the input length and then copies/expands bytes while validating UTF-8 structure."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/krb5/src/lib/krb5/unicode/ucstr.c","function":"krb5int_utf8_normalize","line":260,"var":"out[outpos]","code":"out[outpos] = '\\0';","note":"The root-cause sink is a write into the normalization output buffer; malformed length/sequence handling can drive an out-of-bounds write here."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
